page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance designed for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity and dedicated compute resources. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It delivers 80 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz.

The hardware configuration includes 768.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core. This dense memory allocation is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 25 Gbps to support data-intensive operations. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge provides a high-density memory profile on dedicated physical cores, reducing virtualization overhead and resource contention. This makes it a viable option for enterprise applications where predictable CPU performance and large memory footprints are critical, avoiding the overhead of multi-threading.
This instance is suited for memory-heavy workloads, including large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and high-throughput data processing tasks.
